title: Increases in Unbilled Receivables & Receivables Factorting
summary: MasTec (MTZ) unbilled receivables jumped $320.7M in 2026. See key increases for Eaton, Sunrun, Leidos, and others.
body_markdown:
Companies that saw spikes in unbilled receivables or increased accounts receivable factoring in the last quarter


ticker Company Name Category Current outstanding amount Increase vs prior period Period / context Evidence / commentary Source Market Cap


**MTZ** MasTec Inc Unbilled receivables $1.8942 billion $320.7 million June 30, 2026 vs. December 31, 2025 Unbilled receivables included in contract assets.[2026-07-30 · 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/15615/000001561526000093/mtz-20260630.htm) $20.24B


**ETN** Eaton Corp PLC Unbilled receivables $1,015 million $256 million June 30, 2026 vs. December 31, 2025 Filing states unbilled receivables rose from $759 million to $1,015 million, reflecting higher revenue recognized and not yet billed.[2026-07-31 · 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1551182/000155118226000030/etn-20260630.htm) $158.73B


**RUN** Sunrun Inc Unbilled receivables $1,125.8 million $194.3 million June 30, 2026 vs. December 31, 2025 Majority of unbilled receivables arise from fixed price escalators in long-term customer agreements.[2026-08-05 · 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1469367/000162828026053366/run-20260630.htm) $2.15B


**LDOS** Leidos Holdings Inc Unbilled receivables $918 million $24 million July 3, 2026 vs. January 2, 2026 Current contract assets identified as unbilled receivables; increase attributed primarily to Entrust acquisition and revenue recognized on certain contracts, partly offset by timing of billings.[2026-08-04 · 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1336920/000133692026000246/ldos-20260703.htm) $17.37B


**$MOG-A** Moog Inc Unbilled receivables $823.658 million $79.306 million June 27, 2026 vs. September 27, 2025 Unbilled receivables balance disclosed directly.[2026-07-31 · 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/67887/000119312526325790/mog-20260627.htm) $12.05B


**SYM** Symbotic Inc Unbilled receivables $459.843 million $278.185 million June 27, 2026 vs. September 27, 2025 Change in opening and closing balances primarily results from timing difference between company performance and customer payments.[2026-08-05 · 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1837240/000183724026000043/sym-20260627.htm) $5.20B


**CW** Curtiss-Wright Corp Unbilled receivables $452.380 million $39.970 million June 30, 2026 vs. December 31, 2025 Unbilled receivables reported as contract assets.[2026-08-06 · 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/26324/000162828026054196/cw-20260630.htm) $22.71B


**PSN** Parsons Corp Unbilled receivables $413.758 million $17.869 million June 30, 2026 vs. December 31, 2025 Unbilled accounts receivable are amounts where the company has a present contractual right to bill but invoice has not yet been issued.[2026-07-29 · 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/275880/000119312526322066/psn-20260630.htm) $5.21B
